html:
The Thalanyji are an Aboriginal people of the Pilbara region of Western Australia, in country along the lower Ashburton River and the coast around present day Onslow.

Their neighbours on the map are the Payungu and Buruna to the south, the Tjuroro upriver and the Martuthunira to the north. They fished the coast and rivers and hunted on the inland plains.

From the 1860s sheep stations spread along the Ashburton, and the pearling industry worked the nearby coast, often with forced Aboriginal labour. The Thalanyji were granted native title over much of their country in 2008. See Aboriginal Australian societies for the longer past.
sum: The Thalanyji are an Aboriginal people of the Pilbara region of Western Australia, in country along the lower Ashburton River and the coast around present day Onslow.
